gaps.note: The page asserts that synthetic transforms follow the butterfly scheme with some unstated exponent at each level, and that moving entries between levels is an address rearrangement. It never says which exponent each level uses, what the rearrangement is, or why the levels reproduce the sum defining Z_g. The reader cannot check that the fast levels compute the stated transform.
